ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that in $\triangle ABC$, $DE\parallel BC$ intersects sides $AB$ and $AC$ at points D and E, respectively, and $DE$ divides $\triangle ABC$ into two parts of equal area. Fold $\triangle ADE$ along line $DE$ so that point A falls onto point F, $DF$ intersects $BC$ at point G, connect $CF$. If $CF\parallel AB$, what is the value of the ratio $CF\colon AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw line $AF$, intersecting $DE$ at $M$, and $BC$ at $N$,\\
$\because$ folding triangle $ADE$ along the line $DE$, point $A$ lands on point $F$,\\
$\therefore$ $AF\perp BC$, $AM=FM$,\\
$\because$ $DE\parallel BC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle ADE\sim \triangle ABC$,\\
$\because$ $DE$ divides $\triangle ABC$ into two parts of equal area,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{S_{\triangle ADE}}{S_{\triangle ABC}}=\frac{1}{2}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{AM}{AN}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{AM}{MN}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}-1}=\sqrt{2}+1$,\\
$\therefore$ $AM=(\sqrt{2}+1)MN$,\\
$\therefore$ $MF=AM=(\sqrt{2}+1)MN$, $AN=AM+MN=(\sqrt{2}+1)MN+MN=(\sqrt{2}+2)MN$,\\
$\therefore$ $NF=MF-MN=(\sqrt{2}+1)MN-MN=\sqrt{2}MN$,\\
$\because$ $CF\parallel AB$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{CF}{AB}=\frac{NF}{AN}=\frac{\sqrt{2}MN}{(\sqrt{2}+2)MN}=\boxed{\sqrt{2}-1}$,
